1512ed794a36dd93c656dbc29a412dc438eb8dc0.sourceText:
| 示例 | 讲了什么 | 新出现的语法 | 为什么这样写 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | 最基础的范围 for | `for (int n : v)` | 直接读懂意图："对 v 中每个元素 n" | 这种写法会拷贝每个 int，但 int 很小无所谓 |
| 示例 2 | const auto& vs auto& | `const auto&`、`auto&` | `const auto&` 避免拷贝；`auto&` 可修改元素 | 遍历 string 等大对象时一定要用引用 |
| 示例 3 | 遍历初始值列表和 map | 遍历 `{...}` 和 map | 初始值列表可以直接放在 for 里 | map 遍历出来的是 `std::pair` |
| 示例 4 | 结构化绑定解包 map | `for (const auto& [k, v] : m)` | C++17 语法，key/value 分别起名更清晰 | 如果不用 C++17，可以用示例 3 的方式 |
| 示例 5 | 需要下标时的写法 | `std::size_t i`、传统 for | 相邻元素比较离不开下标 | 不要为了使用新语法牺牲清晰度 |
1512ed794a36dd93c656dbc29a412dc438eb8dc0.translatedText:
| Example | What was explained | Newly appearing syntax | Why it is written this way | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | The most basic range for | `for (int n : v)` | Directly read the intent: "for each element n in v" | This form copies each int, but int is very small so it does not matter |
| Example 2 | const auto& vs auto& | `const auto&`、`auto&` | `const auto&` avoid copying;`auto&` can modify elements | When traversing large objects such as string, be sure to use a reference |
| Example 3 | Traversing an initializer list and a map | Traverse `{...}` and map | An initializer list can be placed directly in the for | What map traversal yields is `std::pair` |
| Example 4 | Structured bindings to unpack a map | `for (const auto& [k, v] : m)` | C++17 syntax, key/value naming them separately is clearer | If you do not use C++17, you can use the approach in Example 3 |
| Example 5 | How to write it when an index is needed | `std::size_t i`、traditional for | Comparing adjacent elements is inseparable from indices | Do not sacrifice clarity just to use new syntax |
